actions.expression: I call the method {string} on the path {string}
actions.description: Calls any method on any path of the API, with an empty JSON body.

actions.expression: I search the keyed table for the id {string}
actions.description: Searches the keyed table by the first id.

actions.expression: I search the keyed table for the ids {string}, {string} and {string}
actions.description: Searches the keyed table by the three ids together.

actions.expression: I search the unordered table for the id {string}
actions.description: Searches the unordered table sequentially by id.

actions.expression: I simulate a loan of {string} for {string} months at {string} percent a year
actions.description: Simulates a loan, sending the amount, the number of months and the yearly rate.

actions.expression: I simulate a loan with the amount {string} written as text, for {string} months at {string} percent a year
actions.description: Simulates a loan whose amount is sent as text instead of as a number.

actions.expression: I simulate a loan without the field {string}
actions.description: Simulates a valid loan leaving out one field (amount, months or annualRate).

actions.expression: the program SEARCH-EXAMPLE is ready with the test data
actions.description: Checks that the program under test is up and loaded with the test data.

actions.expression: the record found has the ids {string}, {string} and {string} and the name {string}
